sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Vertigo, occipital pain, congestive symp-
toms, buzzing in ears. Face pale, twitching of mouth.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Anorexia with great thirst, burning in
stomach, pyrosis, nausea, profuse vomiting, pit of
stomach sensitive. Mouth dry.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Rumbling with contraction of recti
muscles, colic, incessant diarrhoea with purging. Rice
water stools with cramps and chilliness.

sections.label: Stool
sections.text:
Loose, incessant, painless, with painful
cramps in muscles of extremities. Anus inflamed.
Stools green, slimy, and bloody. Fever, emaciation,
somnolence.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare : Resorcin (summer com-
plaint with vomiting) ; Cholos terrapina (cramps of
muscles). Ars,; Verat,
